picks.what: View of the town with the Münster on its hill, steel engraving
picks.why: true general view; abbey church and town on the hill recognizable; frame and caption trimmed
sharp color photo of the city’s main landmark; no modern general view offered

gaps: P0, P2: nothing; P1 and P3: only maps; P5: only an undated park postcard and unrelated Kühlen postcards
notes: Rohbock/Poppel date is from the Commons category (1850s); the factory chimneys fit. Quedenfeldt’s 1909 photo (#6) of a church tower over old houses was not added as a second P4 view: portrait format, and the spire looks like the Citykirche rather than the abbey church its caption names.
